label: Explain tier, refusals handled, reuse measured
notes: Two fixes after version 9: open-ended questions (designs, explanations) that the verifying tiers declined now get an answer written by the model with every calculation machine-checked and labelled unverified; a provider content-policy block is answered as a refusal instead of crashing. The owner's 20-question set is run again head to head, and a new section measures the tokens saved by reuse (cache and intermediate compression) on five pairs of repeated or similar questions. Other sections are kept from version 9.
